tool_args.rationale: Paid observations span short and long H and show positive short-H gain crossing to negative response by H=14.76–20.5, matching the supplied dual-horizon endogenous adaptation law. Fit its four parameters numerically; further probing is not required.

considered_alternatives.option: Acquire extra_fine_trajectory_batch for coupled memory ODE
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed long-horizon negative response after positive short-horizon values directly distinguishes the supplied dual-horizon reversal mechanism; the ODE batch is unnecessary for this model family.
Those mechanisms cannot account for observed sign reversal with horizon, while the dual-horizon law does.
Nuisance readings do not resolve the now-demonstrated horizon-dependent reversal.
